_description: Coach Soul Profile v4.1 — CSIP v3.0 aligned. 3-Dimension architecture enforced (WHAT/HOW/PATH). TTT-stratified skeletons, clause depth per arousal, pragmatic discourse functions, Voice Delta, dimension index. Canonical identity reference for all pipeline skills.

_dimension_index._description: Architectural contract mapping each field to its CSIP v3.0 dimension. Downstream skills MUST load dimensions separately — never collapse WHAT, HOW, and PATH into one prompt block.

_spr_vs_priming_index._description: Distinguishes SPR infrastructure (loaded once, persists across all 92 prompts) from priming data (selected per-prompt based on target emotional register and leadership trait).
_spr_vs_priming_index.priming_part_a_source: Per-archetype aesthetic word cluster (lives in each archetype prompt, NOT in this file)
_spr_vs_priming_index.priming_part_b_source: voice_dna.layer_2_emotional_path_mechanics — subset selected by target emotional register
_spr_vs_priming_index.priming_part_c_source: voice_dna.layer_3_leadership_elevation — subset selected by target leadership trait

_legacy_descriptive._migration_note: These fields are Vocabulary Costume artifacts (Failure 3). No downstream skill may read from this namespace. Use voice_dna.layer_1_construction_mechanics instead.
_legacy_descriptive.voice_tone: drill sergeant with a heart of gold

emotional_dna_ref._description: Pointer to the coach's Emotional DNA profile — the root system from which Voice DNA grows.

trigger_map_ref._description: Pointer to the coach's permanent trigger architecture.

sacred_audio._description: Metadata pointers for voice-extracted identity traits (populated by coach-elicitation via Groq Whisper)

invariance_layer._description: Top-level separation between DNA-level invariants (patterns surviving 4+/5 topics) and topic-specific modulations (patterns in ≤2 topics). Addresses Failure 5 (Topic-Locked Transfer) and Principle 1 (Invariance).
invariance_layer._research: Voice DNA Framework Principle 1 — identity is what survives radical topic change. Step 4 — Cross-Topic Invariance Test.

epistemic_signature._description: Structured profile of how this coach holds certainty and doubt. More invariant than any word choice (Principle 3). Extracted per emotional register.
epistemic_signature._research: Voice DNA Framework Principle 3 — Epistemic Signature. Pennebaker LIWC-22 function words, Barrett Constructionism emotional granularity.

pronoun_shift_map._description: Complete trigger map of pronoun shifts. Each shift logged with topic, emotional moment, and TTT level. Becomes a generative rule in the production layer (Principle 5, Step 5).
pronoun_shift_map._research: Voice DNA Framework Principle 5 — Pronoun Logic. Pennebaker pronoun research — first-person singular correlates with emotional processing depth.

transition_grammar._description: Inter-idea movement patterns — how the coach travels between thought units. Distinct from discourse markers (intra-sentence) and sentence skeletons (intra-sentence structure). Principle 9.
transition_grammar._research: Voice DNA Framework Principle 9 — Transition Grammar. Halliday & Hasan cohesion theory.

collision_dna._description: 5-7 pre-encoded core tensions between coach worldview and tribe reality. THE generative engine of every authentic piece (Principle 12, Step 9). NOT discovered fresh each time.
collision_dna._research: Voice DNA Framework Principle 12 — Collision DNA. Festinger Cognitive Dissonance (1957), Haidt MFT.

voice_dna._description: 3-Layer Voice DNA SPR — Mandate 5 separation. Layer 1 = mechanics. Layer 2 = emotional path. Layer 3 = leadership elevation.
voice_dna._research_basis: CCF Bible Critique v2 Mandates 2+5, Computational Stylometry 60-var discriminator, Pennebaker LIWC-22

layer_1_construction_mechanics._description: How this coach constructs sentences — the mechanical DNA. CSIP v3.0 Component A.

sentence_skeletons_by_ttt._description: CSIP v3.0: sentence skeleton templates for EACH TTT level. The coach writes differently at TTT-03 than TTT-08.

discourse_marker_positions._research: Schiffrin discourse marker analysis — positional signatures AND pragmatic functions under emotional load
discourse_marker_positions._description: CSIP v3.0: each marker mapped by position AND pragmatic function (what it DOES, not just where it sits).

pragmatic_functions._description: Per-marker function classification. What does this marker DO at this position?

clause_depth_by_arousal._description: CSIP v3.0: clause subordination depth per arousal level. How many dependent clauses does the coach embed per sentence at each TTT band?
clause_depth_by_arousal._research: CSIP v3.0 Part Three: Component A — clause depth at each arousal level.

rhythm_signature_by_ttt._description: TTT-stratified rhythm profile. NOT a single average (Principle 10).
rhythm_signature_by_ttt._research: Voice DNA Framework Principle 10 — sentence length under emotional load is a fingerprint.

metaphor_deployment_rules._description: Full What/Why/How/When/Where deployment logic per metaphor domain (Principle 11, Step 10). NOT just content.
metaphor_deployment_rules._research: Voice DNA Framework Principle 11 — deployment logic is more replicable than metaphor content.

stylometric_lr_score._description: Likelihood Ratio from forensic stylometry — quantitative voice match confidence
stylometric_lr_score._research: Computational Stylometry for Authorship Attribution — LR forensic validation

layer_2_emotional_path_mechanics._description: How this coach travels from emotional activation to expression. Derived from Emotional DNA V1-V5.

layer_3_leadership_elevation._description: Which of the 12 Attractive Leader Traits this coach expresses at peak. CSIP v3.0: includes Voice Delta (peak vs average differential).
layer_3_leadership_elevation._research: Normative Voice Profile — peak expression signature per trait. CSIP v3.0 Part Six.

voice_delta._description: CSIP v3.0: The differential between peak and average expression. Elevation moves = present in peak, absent in average. Suppression moves = present in average, absent in peak.
voice_delta._research: CSIP v3.0 Part Six: Stage 0.5 Trait Gap Analysis + Stage 0.6 Normative Profile Construction.

negative_space._description: Mandate 4 — what this coach CANNOT produce without breaking character. Consulted BEFORE positive DNA is loaded.
negative_space._research: CCF Bible Critique v2 Principle 11 + Mandate 4. Voice DNA Framework Principle 7, Step 7.
